task: Static HTML debug page: each sun plane isolated, with its crop, rotation, offset and phase
usage_note: Open tools/sun_debug/index.html directly (file://). Game files untouched (sun_flare.gd, sun.gdshader, map.gd). Regenerate data after changing sun_flare.gd: python3 tools/sun_debug/make_planes.py
open_questions: Does a tile look like the plane in the game? The page ignores yaw/pitch/depth (2D), so only crop, rotation, phase, glow, edge fade and additive sum are checked.
Canvas clips at 1.0; the game's HDR glow above 1.0 is not shown.
handoff: Page shows 5 tiles (PLANES), each with index, yaw, pitch (derived from the Fibonacci direction), offset z, crop centre, crop scale, crop rotation, frame phase, frame shown, glow and spin. Tile image = frame crop with the shader's UV math (uv = centre + R(rot)*(p-0.5)*scale), linear blend of frame f and f+1, round edge fade, glow, additive on black. A combined canvas adds all planes. Frame slider 0..63, play at game FPS, glow on/off, fade on/off, spin slider. Per-plane values are not constants in sun_flare.gd, they are computed in _ready() and _layout(); make_planes.py repeats those formulas (lines 33-56, 69) and reads PLANES, PLANE_GLOW, FPS, SOURCE, FRAME_COUNT, radius, golden by regex. planes.js duplicates planes.json because fetch() fails on file://.

details.verified: planes.json values compared by hand against the GDScript formulas; all 64 image paths (../../art/sun/frames/sun_flare_NN.png from tools/sun_debug) exist on disk.
details.not_checked: Page never opened in a browser: layout, drawing, canvas transform sign conventions (rotation direction), play loop.

bug_2026-10-31.cause: Most likely draw() was gated on ALL 64 images loading (loaded === N), with onerror only logging to the console; any single failed or slow image meant draw() never ran, so tiles stayed at the CSS black with no message. No definite single fault was found in paths, pixels or composite mode, so this is the best-supported cause, not proven.
